name: Foul Play raises Corrupting Whispers' damage bonus from 20% to 25% natively (#1035)
contract: Foul Play 706921 (Cultist Corruption talent, CharacterAdvancement 7072) reads 'Increases the damage bonus provided by your Corrupting Whispers by $s1%.' Spell.dbc: one SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AURA effect, aura 107 SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER, EffectMiscValue 3 (SPELLMOD_EFFECT1), BasePoints 4 DieSides 1 (+5), EffectSpellClassMask word 0 bit 19 (524288), target caster.

The Corrupting Whispers buff the Cultist receives is 706725: the Corrupting Whispers specialization spell 92130 grants helper 805606 (AscensionCultist.cpp SetHelper), whose description embeds @s:706725:0@ and whose proc casts 706725 from the player onto the player (AscensionCultistEvents.cpp, case 805606). 706725's effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_DONE, BasePoints 19 DieSides 1 (20%), EffectMiscValue 126 (all magic schools), and its SpellFamilyFlags word 0 is exactly 524288. The other two records named Corrupting Whispers are 707092 (Rank 'Test Only', family bit 25) and 805606 (the proc helper), neither of which carries the bonus.

Unit::ApplyEffectModifiers applies SPELLMOD_EFFECT1 to effect 0 of a spell cast by the modifier owner, so with Foul Play the player's own 706725 aura is created with 25 instead of 20. Expected: without Foul Play, 706725 carries 20 and raises the Cultist's Shadow damage bonus to 1.20x; with Foul Play it carries 25 and raises it to 1.25x; 707092 and 805606 are never modified.
